title: Cover project environment validation, real-store reload and successful PATCH behavior
outcome: Deterministic behavioral tests cover the existing environment settings validation and persistence/API contracts beyond provider notice writer coverage.
acceptance: Behavioral API/declaration fixtures exercise reserved TERMAL_/ENGRAM_ names, name syntax, value and total size limits, NUL refusal, and Windows duplicate-name equivalence without echoing values.
A disposable existing persistence-store fixture reloads saved project settings, and an actual successful routed PATCH demonstrates replace-all behavior with redacted response.
Reuse existing fixture and settings owners; no Markdown/instruction phrase checks, live services, new product restrictions or changes to the parent's agreed acceptance definition.
